refreshNotes: Carryover year. 2025 Electrified GV70 continues with 77.4 kWh battery, dual-motor AWD (429 hp / 516 lb-ft), and 236 mi EPA range. Two trim packages: Advanced ($66,950 MSRP starting) and Prestige (~$74k) ([KBB 2025](https://www.kbb.com/genesis/electrified-gv70/2025/specs/), [Edmunds 2025](https://www.edmunds.com/genesis/electrified-gv70/2025/features-specs/)). CCS1 charging port. Critically, US assembly at HMMA Alabama makes this the first Hyundai Motor Group vehicle to qualify for the full $7,500 IRA EV tax credit ([Electrek Jan 2025](https://electrek.co/2025/01/02/hyundai-kia-evs-qualify-7500-tax-credit-first-time/)). 14.5-inch infotainment touchscreen.
